name: OpenPipe
tagline: Replace frontier-model spend with a fine-tuned small model.
description: Captures your production OpenAI / Anthropic calls, builds a dataset, fine-tunes a small open-weights model on your traffic, then serves the swap behind your existing SDK. The pitch: 10x cost reduction at parity.
